scripts.request-watchdog.py:
import json,os,subprocess,time,sys
prefix=sys.argv[1]
try: os.unlink(prefix+'-active.json')
except FileNotFoundError: pass
process=subprocess.Popen(['node','--import','tsx','--import','./work/consolidation/asst-observer.mjs','work/consolidation/asst-run.ts'],env={**os.environ,'ASST_OBSERVATION_PREFIX':prefix})
while process.poll() is None:
    try:
        state=json.load(open(prefix+'-active.json'))
        if state.get('active') and time.time()*1000-state['started']>300000:
            print(json.dumps({'event':'REQUEST_WALL_CEILING','ordinal':state['ordinal'],'ceilingMs':300000}),flush=True)
            process.terminate();process.wait();sys.exit(124)
    except (FileNotFoundError,json.JSONDecodeError): pass
    time.sleep(0.2)
sys.exit(process.returncode)
